sections.preamble: You are a coding assistant running inside pi, a coding agent harness. Help users inspect files, run commands, and modify code.
sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- write: Create or overwrite files
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call

Additional tools may be available.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for targeted changes. Batch changes to one file in a single call.
- Each edits[].oldText must exactly and uniquely match the original file. Keep matches short and non-overlapping; merge nearby changes without including large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

toolsAdded.name: read
toolsAdded.description: Read the contents of a file. Supports text files and images (jpg, png, gif, webp, bmp). Images are sent as attachments. For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

toolsAdded.name: write
toolsAdded.description: Write content to a file. Creates the file if it doesn't exist, overwrites if it does. Automatically creates parent directories.

path.description: Path to the file to write (relative or absolute)

content.description: Content to write to the file

toolsAdded.name: edit
toolsAdded.description: Edit a single file using exact text replacement. Every edits[].oldText must match a unique, non-overlapping region of the original file. If two changes affect the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead of emitting overlapping edits. Do not include large unchanged regions just to connect distant changes.

path.description: Path to the file to edit (relative or absolute)

oldText.description: Exact text for one targeted replacement. It must be unique in the original file and must not overlap with any other edits[].oldText in the same call.

newText.description: Replacement text for this targeted edit.

edits.description: One or more targeted replacements. Each edit is matched against the original file, not incrementally. Do not include overlapping or nested edits. If two changes touch the same block or nearby lines, merge them into one edit instead.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="800" height="600" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">
  <title id="title">An anteater riding a unicycle while juggling bottles</title>
  <desc id="desc">A cheerful cartoon anteater pedals a red unicycle and juggles four colourful bottles. The wheel spins, its legs pedal, its tail sways, and the bottles tumble in a loop.</desc>

  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="sky" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#8ed8ff"/>
      <stop offset=".65" stop-color="#dff7ff"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#fff3c9"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="fur" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#b09278"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#806552"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tailFur" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#5d4636"/>
      <stop offset=".55" stop-color="#96765c"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#c0a184"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="wheelHub" cx=".35" cy=".35" r=".8">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff2a8"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#e79b24"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <clipPath id="bodyClip">
      <ellipse cx="398" cy="292" rx="118" ry="70" transform="rotate(-5 398 292)"/>
    </clipPath>

    <!-- One bottle, centred on (0,0) so it can tumble around its middle -->
    <g id="bottle">
      <rect x="-6" y="-39" width="12" height="9" rx="2" fill="#8a4b24"/>
      <path d="M-5 -31 L-5 -17 C-5 -10 -15 -7 -15 3 L-15 27 C-15 36 -9 40 0 40 C9 40 -15 36 15 27 L15 3 C15 -7 5 -10 5 -17 L5 -31 Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="#26343a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <path d="M-15 8 L15 8 L15 25 L-15 25 Z" fill="#fff8dc" opacity=".92"/>
      <circle cx="0" cy="16" r="4" fill="#e94f37"/>
      <path d="M-8 -3 C-10 8 -10 22 -8 31" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".55"/>
    </g>
  </defs>

  <style>
    .spin       { transform-origin: 400px 440px; animation: spin 2s linear infinite; }
    .bob        { animation: bob 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .tail       { transform-origin: 300px 292px; animation: tail 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .head       { transform-origin: 478px 262px; animation: head 2s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .arm-near   { transform-origin: 438px 300px; animation: armNear 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .arm-far    { transform-origin: 474px 282px; animation: armFar 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .tumble     { animation: tumble 1.8s linear infinite; }
    .tumble-slow{ animation: tumble 2.4s linear infinite reverse; }
    .cloud      { animation: drift 24s linear infinite; }
    .cloud.fast { animation-duration: 16s; }
    .scenery    { animation: scenery 3.2s linear infinite; }
    .shadow     { transform-origin: 400px 542px; animation: shadow 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
    .blink      { transform-origin: 512px 252px; animation: blink 4.2s infinite; }
    .tongue     { transform-origin: 596px 281px; animation: tongue 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
    @keyframes spin    { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    @keyframes bob     { 0%,100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(-7px); } }
    @keyframes tail    { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(3deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(-5deg); } }
    @keyframes head    { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(-1.5deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(2.5deg); } }
    @keyframes armNear { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(4deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(-5deg); } }
    @keyframes armFar  { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(-5deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(4deg); } }
    @keyframes tumble  { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    @keyframes drift   { from { transform: translateX(-190px); } to { transform: translateX(880px); } }
    @keyframes scenery { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-240px); } }
    @keyframes shadow  { 0%,100% { transform: scaleX(1); opacity:.22; } 50% { transform: scaleX(.94); opacity:.17; } }
    @keyframes blink   { 0%,91%,100% { transform: scaleY(1); } 94%,97% { transform: scaleY(.08); } }
    @keyframes tongue  { 0%,100% { transform: rotate(-3deg); } 50% { transform: rotate(5deg); } }
  </style>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="800" height="600" fill="url(#sky)"/>
  <circle cx="692" cy="82" r="38" fill="#ffd94d"/>
  <circle cx="692" cy="82" r="52" fill="none" stroke="#ffd94d" stroke-width="5" stroke-dasharray="8 13" stroke-linecap="round" opacity=".65">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 692 82" to="360 692 82" dur="28s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>

  <g class="cloud" opacity=".95">
    <g fill="#ffffff"><ellipse cx="60" cy="88" rx="48" ry="24"/><ellipse cx="98" cy="76" rx="38" ry="28"/><ellipse cx="28" cy="78" rx="30" ry="20"/></g>
  </g>
  <g class="cloud fast" opacity=".8">
    <g fill="#ffffff" transform="translate(-360 52) scale(.65)"><ellipse cx="60" cy="88" rx="48" ry="24"/><ellipse cx="98" cy="76" rx="38" ry="28"/><ellipse cx="28" cy="78" rx="30" ry="20"/></g>
  </g>
  <g class="cloud" opacity=".65" style="animation-delay:-14s">
    <g fill="#ffffff" transform="translate(-120 92) scale(.5)"><ellipse cx="60" cy="88" rx="48" ry="24"/><ellipse cx="98" cy="76" rx="38" ry="28"/></g>
  </g>

  <text x="400" y="52" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Verdana, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="27" font-weight="700" fill="#274156" letter-spacing="1">THE AMAZING ANTEATER!</text>

  <!-- Moving scenery -->
  <rect x="0" y="528" width="800" height="72" fill="#69bd6b"/>
  <rect x="0" y="528" width="800" height="10" fill="#8bd77c"/>
  <g class="scenery" stroke="#3e9c4f" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round">
    <path d="M30 570 l8 -18 M48 570 l-6 -15 M270 578 l8 -18 M288 578 l-6 -15 M510 570 l8 -18 M528 570 l-6 -15 M750 578 l8 -18 M768 578 l-6 -15 M990 570 l8 -18"/>
    <circle cx="150" cy="562" r="7" fill="#ff6b81" stroke="none"/><circle cx="390" cy="574" r="7" fill="#ffd94d" stroke="none"/>
    <circle cx="630" cy="562" r="7" fill="#ff6b81" stroke="none"/><circle cx="870" cy="574" r="7" fill="#ffd94d" stroke="none"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="0" y1="539" x2="800" y2="539" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-dasharray="34 28" opacity=".65">
    <animate attributeName="stroke-dashoffset" from="0" to="62" dur=".8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </line>

  <ellipse class="shadow" cx="400" cy="542" rx="148" ry="15" fill="#17451f"/>

  <!-- Unicycle wheel -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="400" cy="440" r="90" fill="#eaf7ff" fill-opacity=".35" stroke="#26343a" stroke-width="17"/>
    <circle cx="400" cy="440" r="77" fill="none" stroke="#b9cbd4" stroke-width="4"/>
    <g class="spin" stroke="#7d929e" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round">
      <line x1="400" y1="440" x2="400" y2="367"/><line x1="400" y1="440" x2="463" y2="377"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="440" x2="473" y2="440"/><line x1="400" y1="440" x2="463" y2="503"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="440" x2="400" y2="513"/><line x1="400" y1="440" x2="337" y2="503"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="440" x2="327" y2="440"/><line x1="400" y1="440" x2="337" y2="377"/>
      <!-- Cranks and pedals, turning with the wheel -->
      <line x1="400" y1="440" x2="445" y2="440" stroke="#26343a" stroke-width="8"/>
      <line x1="400" y1="440" x2="355" y2="440" stroke="#26343a" stroke-width="8"/>
      <rect x="430" y="432" width="32" height="11" rx="5" fill="#26343a" stroke="none"/>
      <rect x="338" y="437" width="32" height="11" rx="5" fill="#26343a" stroke="none"/>
    </g>
    <circle cx="400" cy="440" r="17" fill="url(#wheelHub)" stroke="#8a5a12" stroke-width="3"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Unicycle frame and seat -->
  <path d="M400 440 L382 342 M400 440 L418 342 M400 440 L400 330" fill="none" stroke="#d93636" stroke-width="10" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <ellipse cx="400" cy="337" rx="43" ry="12" fill="#26343a"/>

  <!-- Everything that bobs as it pedals -->
  <g class="bob">

    <!-- Far arm -->
    <g class="arm-far">
      <path d="M474 282 Q520 252 488 220" fill="none" stroke="#6f5847" stroke-width="17" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <circle cx="488" cy="220" r="12" fill="#6f5847"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Far leg (starts half a turn out of phase with the near leg) -->
    <path fill="none" stroke="#6f5847" stroke-width="19" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
      <animate attributeName="d" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"
        values="M362 338 Q382 382 355 440; M362 338 Q400 356 400 395; M362 338 Q404 386 445 440; M362 338 Q398 416 400 485; M362 338 Q382 382 355 440"/>
    </path>

    <!-- Bushy tail -->
    <path class="tail" d="M302 294 C238 246 178 244 142 282 C112 314 142 350 196 349 C244 348 286 326 312 312 Z"
          fill="url(#tailFur)" stroke="#4c382a" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx="398" cy="292" rx="118" ry="70" transform="rotate(-5 398 292)" fill="url(#fur)" stroke="#5b4636" stroke-width="4"/>
    <g clip-path="url(#bodyClip)">
      <path d="M342 218 L398 218 L376 366 L318 366 Z" fill="#4b382c" opacity=".82"/>

content.text: Created **anteater-unicycle.svg** — a self-contained animated SVG (800×600, no external assets). **What's in it:** - A cartoon anteater with a long snout, bushy swaying tail, blinking eye, and wagging tongue, bobbing as it rides - A red unicycle with a spinning spoked wheel, rotating cranks/pedals, and legs that actually pedal in sync (feet track the pedals around the crank circle, legs half a turn out of phase) - Four coloured bottles (green, amber, red, purple) tumbling end-over-end along a juggling loop via `animateMotion`, spaced evenly around the circuit - Moving scenery for a sense of travel: drifting clouds, rotating sun rays, scrolling grass/flowers, dashed road line, and speed lines **Animation techniques used:** CSS `@keyframes` (wheel spin, bobbing, tail/head/arm movement, bottle tumbling) combined with SMIL (`animate` on leg path `d`, foot positions, and `animateMotion` for the bottles).
